scope: User-requested restricted normal-room development study; not independent validation or a real-IMU threshold

protocol.x: Visited neighbourhood fraction of all body-clear floor, including unreachable components; radius0.25m; not full room area
protocol.y: Independent furniture visits; overlapping classifier windows are not visits
protocol.z_primary: Fraction of all selected rooms with all four predicted centres within0.5m
protocol.z_secondary: Mean fraction of four objects with centre error within tolerance
protocol.known_information: Room box, registered metric coordinates, four target classes and exact nominal sizes
protocol.error_model: Ideal walk coordinates, declared 0.15m L-infinity body clearance; contact bound0.20m; not a calibrated real-IMU bound
protocol.frontier_rule: Rate>=0.80 and next two coverage and next two count grades all pass; no monotonic smoothing
protocol.missing_rule: Zero-area object invalidates geometry input and is excluded before scoring; unreached coverage or unexecutable visits are censored, lower/upper response rates and availability reported
protocol.joint_solver: Continuous-region proposals; exact star constraints bed-desk non-overlap and bed-storage overlap<=1%; storage-desk and chair projections allowed to overlap; no target position read
protocol.contact_protocol: Cabinet events on one already reachable operation face; bed/seat contact can enter their footprint
protocol.duplicate_rule: Repeated exact same contact is redundant under deterministic geometry; counted as a visit but not independent information
protocol.walk_evidence: Only trusted walk samples exclude every object; stronger than the old desk/cab-only pipeline
protocol.statistical_unit: Room; all rooms reused development data
